column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules for the DAST job (.github/workflows/dast.yml).
#   action = IGNORE  accepted or not applicable, never fails the scan
#            WARN    reported, does not fail the scan (the default for anything not listed)
#            FAIL    reported and fails the scan
#   url-regex: leave empty to apply to every URL, otherwise a Python regex matched against the URL
# Every IGNORE carries a note saying why it is accepted.
